```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A uniform row or column is the divider.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if rows:
        r = min(rows, key=lambda x: abs(x - (h - 1) / 2))
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        common = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for part in (top, bottom) for row in part for v in row))
        return [[3 if top[i][j] == bottom[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)]
                for i in range(n)]

    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if cols:
        c = cols[0]
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for part in (left, right) for row in part for v in row))
        return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else bg for j in range(n)]
                for i in range(h)]

    return grid
```
